title: FLUX.3 Block Offload 预取深度

standard.summary: 提前载入 GPU 的后续 Transformer block 数。默认 1。
standard.effect: 控制 offload 预取后续 block 的深度。
standard.whenToUse: 默认值适用于通常情况；只有在传输等待明显时再小幅增加。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存余量不足时不要增加预取深度。

standard_en.summary: Number of upcoming Transformer blocks prefetched to the GPU. Default: 1.
standard_en.effect: Controls how far ahead block offload loads blocks onto the GPU.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep the default for typical runs; increase slightly only when transfer stalls are evident.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not increase prefetch depth when VRAM headroom is insufficient.
